title: Client Relationship Management Executive
description:
WERE HIRING – ACCOUNT MANAGER 
 Client Relationship Management | Account Management | Business Development – Domestic IT Recruitment 
 Location: Bangalore
 Experience: 5–10 Years
 Employment: Full-Time
 Work Mode: Onsite / Bangalore
 Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred 
 ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for an experienced Account Manager / Client Relationship Manager / Business Development Manager with 5–10 years of hands-on experience in Domestic IT Recruitment, Client Management, Account Management and Business Development . 
 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in managing enterprise IT clients, developing long-term client relationships, understanding recruitment requirements, driving business growth and ensuring successful recruitment delivery . 
 Candidates with experience managing large IT Services Companies, System Integrators, MSP/RPO accounts or enterprise clients will be highly preferred. 
 Candidates must be currently living in Bangalore. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Client Relationship & Account Management Act as the primary point of contact for assigned IT clients and enterprise accounts. Build, maintain and strengthen long-term client relationships with HR, Talent Acquisition, Procurement and Business stakeholders. Understand client hiring plans, workforce requirements, recruitment challenges and business priorities. Conduct regular client meetings, requirement reviews and account performance discussions . Ensure high levels of client satisfaction and service quality. Handle escalations and proactively resolve client concerns. Develop strong relationships across multiple stakeholders within client organizations. 
 Business Development & Growth Identify opportunities for new business, account expansion, upselling and cross-selling recruitment services. Generate and develop new client relationships within the Domestic IT Recruitment / Staffing market. Participate in client meetings, presentations, capability discussions and commercial negotiations. Develop a strong pipeline of prospective clients and business opportunities. Understand market requirements and identify opportunities to expand existing accounts. Work towards achieving business development, revenue and account growth targets . 
 Recruitment Delivery & Account Performance Take ownership of recruitment delivery for assigned accounts. Understand and manage high-volume as well as niche IT recruitment requirements . Coordinate with recruitment teams to ensure timely candidate submissions, interviews and closures. Monitor SLA, TAT, ageing requirements, submissions, interviews, closures and fulfilment metrics . Work closely with recruiters and delivery teams to improve account performance. Ensure recruitment commitments made to clients are delivered within agreed timelines. Prepare and review MIS, account reports, performance dashboards and client updates . 
 Stakeholder & Team Management Coordinate effectively between clients, recruitment teams, delivery managers and leadership . Guide recruiters on client expectations, job requirements and submission quality. Conduct regular account reviews and identify gaps in delivery. Take complete ownership of client satisfaction, account performance and business outcomes . 
 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR 5–10 years of hands-on experience in Domestic IT Recruitment, Client Relationship Management, Account Management, Business Development or IT Staffing. Strong and demonstrable experience in client-facing roles . Proven experience managing IT clients / enterprise accounts / System Integrators / large IT Services organizations . Strong experience in client relationship management and account growth . Hands-on exposure to Business Development, lead generation, new client acquisition and account expansion . Experience handling recruitment requirements from requirement gathering through fulfilment and closure . Strong understanding of Domestic IT Recruitment, staffing and IT technologies . Experience managing multiple clients, high-volume requirements and critical/niche positions . Strong negotiation, presentation, communication and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to independently manage client relationships and drive account performance. Strong commercial and business-development mindset. Target-oriented with excellent ownership, follow-up and execution skills. Must be currently residing in Bangalore. Candidates who can join immediately or at short notice will be preferred. 
 DESIRED BACKGROUND Candidates from IT Staffing, Recruitment Services, RPO, MSP, System Integrators or IT Services environments with exposure to enterprise client management will be preferred. 

 KEY SKILLS Client Relationship Management | Client Management | Account Management | Key Account Management | Business Development | BDM | New Client Acquisition | Account Growth | IT Staffing | Domestic IT Recruitment | Enterprise Accounts | Requirement Gathering | Stakeholder Management | Negotiation | Client Retention | Recruitment Delivery | SLA Management | MIS | Team Coordination 
 WHY JOIN US? Opportunity to manage and grow enterprise IT accounts Exposure to client relationship and business development Opportunity to work closely with senior client stakeholders Performance-driven career growth Fast-paced and entrepreneurial recruitment environment Opportunity to progress into Senior Account Manager / Business Development Manager / Account Head roles 
 IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT Only candidates currently residing in Bangalore with 5–10 years of relevant hands-on experience in Client Management, Account Management, Business Development and/or Domestic IT Recruitment should apply.

title: US Accountant
description:
We are looking for a Finance Shared Services Lead with strong U.S. accounting knowledge, CA-level accounting judgment, and advanced hands-on QuickBooks proficiency. This is a functional and hands-on role, not a basic bookkeeping position. The selected candidate will actively support U.S. finance operations, work with clients and internal teams, manage reconciliations, support billing and collections, support payroll, prepare financial reports, and use QuickBooks as an analytics and reporting tool. The role requires strong ownership, accuracy, client-facing communication, and the ability to convert accounting data into clear financial insights for management. Key Responsibilities 1. QuickBooks Accounting & Analytics Use QuickBooks for accounting, reporting, reconciliations, and financial analysis. Review transactions for proper classification, coding, documentation, and consistency. Generate and analyze P&L, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, General Ledger, AR Aging, AP Aging, vendor, customer, project/job, and cash-flow-related reports. Identify unusual transactions, incorrect coding, duplicate entries, missing documentation, aging issues, reconciliation gaps, and margin concerns. Prepare QuickBooks-based management summaries, variance reports, account schedules, and financial insights. Support improvements in chart of accounts, customer/vendor setup, class/location/project tracking, and reporting discipline. 2. Reconciliations Perform and review bank, credit card, AR, AP, payroll, and balance sheet reconciliations. Reconcile QuickBooks records with bank statements, credit card statements, payroll reports, billing records, payment receipts, and supporting schedules. Investigate unreconciled items, timing differences, incorrect entries, duplicate entries, and unusual transactions. Maintain clean reconciliation files with proper backup and audit trail. 3. Client-Facing Finance Support Coordinate with U.S.-based clients and internal teams on billing, payment status, reconciliations, documentation, and accounting queries. Support client billing cycles, AR follow-ups, account statements, and reconciliation discussions. Ensure client-facing financial data is accurate, complete, and supported by proper documentation. Resolve missing, disputed, or incomplete billing/accounting information with the relevant teams. 4. Accounts Receivable, Billing & Collections Review invoices based on approved rates, contracts, timesheets, work orders, and client requirements. Ensure invoices have proper backup before submission. Track invoice submissions, payments, short payments, credits, adjustments, and disputed items. Maintain AR aging and follow-up trackers. Escalate overdue accounts and unresolved billing matters with clear facts and supporting documentation. 5. Accounts Payable & Vendor Accounting Manage vendor bills, expense entries, approvals, and supporting documentation. Maintain vendor ledgers and ensure payables are properly recorded in QuickBooks. Support payment planning, vendor reconciliations, and AP aging review. Resolve vendor billing discrepancies with internal teams. 6. Payroll Accounting Support Support bi-weekly U.S. payroll accounting and reconciliation activities. Validate payroll inputs such as hours, overtime, PTO, unpaid leave, adjustments, bonuses, and reimbursements. Cross-check payroll data against timesheets, approvals, project logs, payroll reports, and accounting entries. Maintain payroll logs, payroll entries, schedules, and audit documentation. Major Plus: Experience with Paychex Payroll or similar U.S. payroll systems. 7. Financial Reporting, MIS & Business Analysis Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports and summaries. Support financial statements, management reports, budgets, forecasts, and projections. Analyze trends, variances, cash flow, AR/AP movement, expense patterns, and business performance. Prepare dashboards, KPI summaries, and management reporting packs using QuickBooks, Excel, Google Sheets, and other reporting tools. Work with executives and business heads to track profit/loss by business unit, project, client, or function. 8. Month-End/ Quarter End, Year End Closeouts, Audit & Controls Support month-end / quarter-end/ year end close by preparing schedules, reconciliations, reports, and journal entries. Review AP, AR, payroll, bank, credit card, accrual, prepaid, revenue, and expense records before close. Coordinate with CPA, U.S. accountants, auditors, tax advisors, and internal finance teams. Prepare audit-ready documentation for quarterly, annual, statutory, tax, and client-related audits. Identify control gaps, reporting weaknesses, reconciliation issues, and process risks. Key Accountabilities Accurate QuickBooks accounting, reporting, and analytics. Clean and timely reconciliations. Accurate AR, AP, payroll, bank, credit card, and balance sheet schedules. Timely client billing support and AR follow-up. Clear financial reports, variance summaries, and management insights. Audit-ready records and documentation. Strong coordination with U.S. clients, internal teams, and leadership. Proper escalation of discrepancies, risks, and unresolved finance issues. Qualifications & Experience CA, CA Inter, CPA, ACCA, CMA, MBA Finance, M.Com, B.Com, or equivalent accounting/finance qualification. Strong preference for CA-qualified, CA Inter, CPA, or CA-level candidates. 6+ years of hands-on experience in accounting, reconciliations, financial reporting, AR, AP, payroll accounting, and finance operations. Advanced hands-on proficiency in QuickBooks is required. Must be able to use QuickBooks for reporting, reconciliations, financial analysis, variance review, trend analysis, management reporting, and audit support. Prior experience with U.S. accounting, U.S. payroll, invoicing, audit, or client finance operations preferred. Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial statements, internal controls, and audit documentation. Experience with timesheet-based invoicing, project-based accounting, construction services, engineering services, or professional services billing is a strong plus. Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills required. Experience with Power BI, dashboards, reporting automation, ERP platforms, or accounting analytics tools preferred. Strong English communication skills and ability to coordinate with U.S.-based clients and teams. Ability to work full U.S. Eastern Time hours. Required Competencies Advanced QuickBooks proficiency, especially for analytics and reporting. Strong accounting and reconciliation discipline. CA-level accounting judgment. High attention to detail and accuracy. Strong financial analysis and variance review ability. Client-facing communication skills. Ownership, follow-through, and deadline discipline. Strong documentation and audit-readiness mindset. Ability to work independently within defined finance controls. High integrity and confidentiality when handling financial, payroll, and client information

Key Skills: US Accounting,US GAAP Accounting,US GAAP,US Tax,CHARTERED ACCOUNTANT,Accounting,Quick Books,Accounts Receivable
